{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix and template addition",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 4)

    # Load pipette
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])

    # Define liquids
    protocol.define_liquid(name="mix", description="master mix for qPCR", display_color="#0000FF")

    # Define source liquids for each well
    for row in "ABCDEFGHI":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            source_liquid_name = f"source_{well_name}"
            protocol.define_liquid(name=source_liquid_name,
                                   description=f"Sample from {well_name}",
                                   display_color="#FF0000")
    # Load master mix into reservoir
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid="mix", volume=1600)

    # Load source liquids into source plate wells
    for row in "ABCDEFGHI":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            source_liquid_name = f"source_{well_name}"
            source_well = source_plate[well_name]
            source_well.load_liquid(liquid=source_liquid_name, volume=100)

    # Transfer mix and template into each well of destination plate
    for row in "ABCDEFGHI":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            dest_well = dest_plate[well_name]
            source_well = source_plate[well_name]

            # Pick up a new tip
            p300.pick_up_tip()

            # Aspirate 15 ul of master mix
            p300.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"])

            # Dispense 15 ul into destination well
            p300.dispense(15, dest_well)

            # Aspirate 5 ul of template from source well
            p300.aspirate(5, source_well)

            # Dispense 5 ul into destination well
            p300.dispense(5, dest_well)

            # Drop tip
            p300.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix and template addition",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 4)

    # Load pipette
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips])

    # Define liquids
    mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="mix", description="master mix for qPCR", display_color="#0000FF")

    # Define source liquids for each well and store objects
    source_liquids = {}
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            source_liquid_obj = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"source_{well_name}",
                                                       description=f"Sample from {well_name}",
                                                       display_color="#FF0000")
            source_liquids[well_name] = source_liquid_obj

    # Load master mix into reservoir
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=mix, volume=1600)

    # Load source liquids into source plate wells
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            source_well = source_plate[well_name]
            source_well.load_liquid(liquid=source_liquids[well_name], volume=100)

    # Transfer mix and template into each well of destination plate
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            dest_well = dest_plate[well_name]
            source_well = source_plate[well_name]

            # Pick up a new tip
            p300.pick_up_tip()

            # Aspirate 15 ul of master mix
            p300.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"])

            # Dispense 15 ul into destination well
            p300.dispense(15, dest_well)

            # Aspirate 5 ul of template from source well
            p300.aspirate(5, source_well)

            # Dispense 5 ul into destination well
            p300.dispense(5, dest_well)

            # Drop tip
            p300.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix and template addition",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 4)

    # Load pipette
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips_20])

    # Define liquids
    mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="mix", description="master mix for qPCR", display_color="#0000FF")
    
    # Define source liquids for each well and store objects
    source_liquids = {}
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            if well_name == "H12":
                # NTC well: water instead of sample
                water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="nuclease-free water", display_color="#00FFFF")
                source_liquids[well_name] = water
            else:
                source_liquid_obj = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"source_{well_name}",
                                                          description=f"Sample from {well_name}",
                                                          display_color="#FF0000")
                source_liquids[well_name] = source_liquid_obj

    # Load master mix into reservoir
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=mix, volume=1600)
    
    # Load source liquids into source plate wells
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            source_well = source_plate[well_name]
            source_well.load_liquid(liquid=source_liquids[well_name], volume=100)

    # Transfer mix and template into each well of destination plate
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            dest_well = dest_plate[well_name]
            source_well = source_plate[well_name]

            # Pick up a new tip
            p20.pick_up_tip()

            # Aspirate 5 ul of template (or water for NTC)
            p20.aspirate(5, source_well)

            # Dispense 5 ul into destination well
            p20.dispense(5, dest_well)

            # Aspirate 15 ul of master mix from reservoir (stay in liquid)
            p20.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"].bottom(0.5))

            # Dispense 15 ul into destination well
            p20.dispense(15, dest_well)

            # Mix the well
            p20.mix(5, 5, dest_well)

            # Drop tip
            p20.drop_tip()"}

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix and template addition",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 4)

    # Load pipette
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips_20])

    # Define liquids
    mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="mix", description="master mix for qPCR", display_color="#0000FF")

    # Define source liquids for each well and store objects
    source_liquids = {}
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            if well_name == "H12":
                # NTC well: water instead of sample
                water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="nuclease-free water", display_color="#00FFFF")
                source_liquids[well_name] = water
            else:
                source_liquid_obj = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"source_{well_name}",
                                                          description=f"Sample from {well_name}",
                                                          display_color="#FF0000")
                source_liquids[well_name] = source_liquid_obj

    # Load master mix into reservoir
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=mix, volume=1600)

    # Load source liquids into source plate wells
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            source_well = source_plate[well_name]
            source_well.load_liquid(liquid=source_liquids[well_name], volume=100)

    # Transfer mix and template into each well of destination plate
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            dest_well = dest_plate[well_name]
            source_well = source_plate[well_name]

            # Pick up a new tip
            p20.pick_up_tip()

            # Aspirate 15 ul of master mix
            p20.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"].bottom(0.5))

            # Dispense 15 ul into destination well
            p20.dispense(15, dest_well)

            # Aspirate 5 ul of template (or water for NTC)
            p20.aspirate(5, source_well)

            # Dispense 5 ul into destination well
            p20.dispense(5, dest_well)

            # Mix the well
            p20.mix(5, 16, dest_well)

            # Drop tip
            p20.drop_tip()"}

{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "PCR setup with master mix and template addition",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    tips_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 2)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr", 4)

    # Load pipette
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tips_20])

    # Define liquids
    mix = protocol.define_liquid(name="mix", description="master mix for qPCR", display_color="#0000FF")

    # Define source liquids for each well and store objects
    source_liquids = {}
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            if well_name == "H12":
                # NTC well: water instead of sample
                water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="nuclease-free water", display_color="#00FFFF")
                source_liquids[well_name] = water
            else:
                source_liquid_obj = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"source_{well_name}",
                                                          description=f"Sample from {well_name}",
                                                          display_color="#FF0000")
                source_liquids[well_name] = source_liquid_obj

    # Load master mix into reservoir
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=mix, volume=1600)

    # Load source liquids into source plate wells
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            source_well = source_plate[well_name]
            source_well.load_liquid(liquid=source_liquids[well_name], volume=100)

    # Transfer mix and template into each well of destination plate
    for row in "ABCDEFGH":
        for col in range(1,13):
            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            dest_well = dest_plate[well_name]
            source_well = source_plate[well_name]

            # Pick up a new tip
            p20.pick_up_tip()

            # Aspirate 15 ul of master mix
            p20.aspirate(15, reservoir["A1"].bottom(0.5))

            # Dispense 15 ul into destination well
            p20.dispense(15, dest_well)

            # Aspirate 5 ul of template (or water for NTC)
            p20.aspirate(5, source_well)

            # Dispense 5 ul into destination well
            p20.dispense(5, dest_well)

            # Mix the well
            p20.mix(5, 16, dest_well)

            # Drop tip
            p20.drop_tip()"}

protocol.py: 3 biology problems (1 error, 1 warning, 1 note).

1. ERROR SOURCE-TOO-SHALLOW: The pipette draws air from well A1 in slot 3: the liquid is
below the tip
   line 69:  p20.mix(5, 16, dest_well)
   At line 69 the p20_single_gen2 draws 16 ul from well A1 in slot 3 with its tip 1 mm above
   the bottom of the well. By then the well holds 20 ul, which in this NEST 96 Well Plate
   200 µL Flat reaches only 0.63 mm up: the tip is above the liquid and draws air (this line
   did it 480 times; 7,680 ul of air in all). The simulator does not notice: it does not
   follow the liquid. These are mixing strokes: the tip stirs air, and the well is not
   mixed. Source wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 3.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Mix lower, with `well.bottom(0.5)`, so the tip is in the liquid. This well needs
   about 35 ul in it for the surface to reach 1 mm.
   Source: Opentrons: liquid control (aspirates 1 mm above the bottom of the well by
   default)
           https://docs.opentrons.com/v2/basic_commands/liquids.html
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   Source: Gilson guide to pipetting (immersion depth 2 to 3 mm for 1 to 100 ul)
           https://solutions.pipette.com/wp-content/uploads/Gilson-Guide-to-Pipetting.pdf
   Source: labautomation.io 7592: negative controls positive after aspirating air
           https://labautomation.io/t/aspiration-dispense-liquid-class-incompatibity/7592
   Source: Integra: 260 ul dead volume in a standard reservoir
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/minimizing-dead-volume-during-qpcr-set-divided-reservoir-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   [ef6c36279f75]

2. WARNING CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: 96 stocks
   line 63:  p20.aspirate(5, source_well)
   At line 63 the tip went into source_A1 (well A1 in slot 4), source_A2 (well A2 in slot
   4), source_A3 (well A3 in slot 4), source_A4 (well A4 in slot 4) and 92 more while it
   still carried mix (well A1 in slot 2) from an earlier step (this line did it 96 times). A
   tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it in the next liquid it touches, so
   these stocks now hold material that does not belong there. The protocol does not draw
   from them again, so this run is not harmed, but what is left in the stock is no longer
   clean for the next run.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 4.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 63 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
   Source: WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing
           https://www.who.int/teams/global-malaria-programme/case-management/diagnosis/nucleic-acid-amplification-based-diagnostics/dos-and-don-ts-for-molecular-testing
   [73412772f717]

3. NOTE UNMIXED-AT-END: 96 wells never mixed after source_A1, source_A2, source_A3,
source_A4 and 92 more went in (25% of the well)
   line 66:  p20.dispense(5, dest_well)
   At line 66 the robot added source_A1, source_A2, source_A3, source_A4 and 92 more to
   wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 3, which already held mix (this
   line did it 96 times). The addition was 25% of the well, nothing mixed the well
   afterwards, and the run ended with them that way. Two liquids layered in a small well do
   not mix on their own, so what the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated.
   A PCR plate is usually vortexed and spun down before cycling; if this one will not be,

   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 3.
